title: Backend Core Version Contract Consumer Hardening Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, Backend, and Core heads, repository AGENTS rules, and current version capability evidence before product edits.
items.evidenceTarget: Exact Project Control, Backend, and Core commits plus clean/dirty state, AGENTS.md rules, and relevant Core/Backend version capability files are recorded for the Backend lane.

items.label: Inventory Backend version capability facts and classify whether each is a Core contract consumption, Backend wrapper, copied value, retained response shape, or deletion candidate.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend source/test inventory shows whether Core capability or retirement-inventory facts are imported, copied, wrapped, retained, deleted, or blocked.

items.label: Write a failing Backend test that would catch drift between Backend reporting and Core-owned version capability or retirement-inventory facts.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Backend test output fails before implementation because the drift guard or consumer contract is missing or weak.

items.label: Implement the smallest Backend change that consumes or verifies Core-owned version facts without widening Backend readiness claims.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend implementation and focused tests prove Core capability facts are wrapped or compared safely, and copied values are removed or classified.

items.label: Preserve Backend ownership of revision gates, migration persistence, source retention, and HTTP response semantics while consuming Core facts.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend tests show revision and persistence semantics remain Backend-owned and do not treat Core migration-target validation as service readiness.

items.label: Run focused Backend checks plus the full Backend gate in the worktree and on merged main.
items.evidenceTarget: Fresh Backend worktree and merged-main verification pass, or failures are recorded as blockers with exact output.

items.label: Register Project Control evidence for the bounded Backend consumer-hardening result without promoting broad Backend, Core, or FlowDoc truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence target evidence-backend-core-version-contract-consumer-hardening-2026-08-27 cites exact commits, paths, commands, supported claims, risks, and unknowns.
